comparison.objective: Candidate fractures and recovers four HELICOIL tangs; record inspects concealed slider travel and marks the largest travel.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial mandrel placement, stabilized hammer impact, and tiny-fragment recovery; record tests travel inspection and marking. No specs provide further rubric detail.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contact-driven notch fractures, physical containment of all fragments, retained inserts, and no damage; record body only reports task/demo scores and does not state detailed success thresholds.
comparison.reason: Inspection and marking of slider travel tests a meaningfully different ability from controlled insert-tang fracture and fragment recovery.
